outcome: location of CSSE within the scar
cohort: The study analyzed 53 patients who underwent surgery for cesarean section scar endometriosis (CSSE) between 2019-2024.
finding: Adipose-layer CSSE typically presented with swelling at scar corners, whereas muscle-layer CSSE presented with pain at the midline and had significantly higher CA-125 levels, with pain and elevated CA-125 independently associated with muscle-layer CSSE.
mod_finding: The study found that the presentation and biochemical markers of cesarean section scar endometriosis (CSSE), a direct complication of cesarean birth, differed significantly based on whether the lesion was in the adipose or muscle layer of the scar.
followup_time: Symptoms began 40.4 ± 23.5 months after cesarean section.
